'''Star Tours Flight 416''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight arriving at [[Spaceport THX1138]] from [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. Its destination was Gate 1A, and its status was on time, with an estimated time of arrival of 1320 hours.
